beats.event: Mary lives neglected in colonial India, spoiled and sour
Cholera epidemic kills her parents; servants flee
British soldiers place her with a clergyman who mocks her
Sent to uncle's bleak Misselthwaite Manor on the moors
Learns aunt Lilias is dead and uncle Archibald is a hunchback
Befriends maid Martha; hears tale of the locked garden
A robin shows her the buried key to the secret garden
Meets Dickon; together they revive the garden
Follows crying and discovers invalid cousin Colin in bed
Distracts Colin with tales of moor, Dickon, and the garden
Colin taken outside in wheelchair; enters the garden
Furious at Ben's taunt, Colin stands up on his own legs
Children conspire to keep Colin's recovery a joyful secret
Archibald, drawn by a dream, returns to Misselthwaite
Archibald finds Colin racing in the blooming garden
